name: Open teacher mobile sync and keep pairing available
description: Verifies the existing desktop workflow for pairing teachers and publishing their read-only timetable remains available after notification delivery is removed.
steps: Review the pairing QR workflow and paired device controls
expected: The pairing and device management workflow remains usable and does not require notification sign-in.

name: Save local reminder preferences in the teacher portal
description: Verifies teachers can change reminder preferences without signing into AppDeploy or registering for push delivery.
steps: Change the before-lesson reminder to 15 minutes
Reload the portal and review the selected value
expected: The preference remains stored on the device and the portal explains that reliable background reminders require the Android APK.

name: Use the cached timetable while offline
description: Verifies a previously paired teacher can continue to view the locally cached timetable without internet access.
setup: Pair a teacher phone and allow its timetable snapshot to be cached
steps: Disconnect the device from the internet
Review the current week's lessons and reminder preferences
expected: The saved timetable and local reminder preferences remain visible; no notification API request is required.

name: Reject notification activation in a browser-only portal
description: Verifies the hosted web portal does not pretend to provide reliable native background notifications.
steps: Open notification settings in the hosted teacher portal
expected: The portal explains that native local notifications require the Collkip Android APK and does not initiate AppDeploy push subscription.
